page: Google Cloud Platform n4a-highmem-16 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the n4a server family. It is equipped with 16 dedicated vCPUs based on the arm64 CPU architecture. The instance features 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. This configuration does not include local NVMe storage or bundled GPUs, and it does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Utilizing the arm64 architecture, this instance is designed for workloads that benefit from high memory density and energy-efficient ARM execution. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the arm64 architecture combined with a high-memory configuration offers a favorable resource-to-cost profile for memory-intensive applications compared to traditional x86 alternatives, allowing organizations to run larger in-memory datasets within a moderate compute footprint.

The n4a-highmem-16 is suited for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local storage or GPU acceleration. Appropriate use cases include in-memory databases, caching layers, data buffering, enterprise applications with large memory footprints, and medium-scale data processing pipelines.
